name: Base relief (land of the wine-making countries)

sources.name: Terrain Tiles on AWS Open Data (Mapzen / Joerd)
sources.licence: open data with required attribution (registry licence: https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md)
sources.resolution: Terrarium zoom 9 (about 300 m a pixel at the equator, 150 m at 60 N), reduced 2x2 for zooms 8 to 5

sources.name: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 countries (tile selection and the sea mask)

attribution: Relief: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen/Joerd); SRTM and GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; ETOPO1 terrain data U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
Relief, Europe: produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union - EU-DEM layers
Relief, Canada: contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada

notMapped: contours, hachures and the 3D heightmap (hillshade only)
appellations, vineyards and parcels (the map region layer draws appellations)
land of countries with no wine row in the map data (their land inside a tile that also holds a wine country is drawn)

build.rules: terrain.py hillshade unchanged (Horn, NW 45 deg, shade/flat, exaggeration 1 + 0.18 * (13 - z), WebP q70 m6, tiles lighter than 247 everywhere not written); cell size per pixel row; sea pixels (outside every Natural Earth country, below 0 m or unknown) set to 0 m; source tiles fetched for every land tile under the written tiles plus one tile of margin (no filled edges); relief on land outside the kept countries (the wine countries plus enclaves wholly inside the selection) fades to white from 8 to 32 z9 pixels beyond the kept border
